# Ritz Mpindi

> Ritz Mpindi is a go-to-market and storytelling operator based in New York. Ritz works in business development at Bridger Consulting Group and runs CØNVERGENCE, an advisory practice in New York that gives pre-seed to Series C startups strategic brand, marketing and program leadership. The through-line: moving capital, relevance and influence through relationships.

## Pages

- [Ritz Mpindi](https://ritzmpindi.com/): selected work, screening room, clients, career index and contact
- [CØNVERGENCE Advisory](https://ritzmpindi.com/advisory.html): fractional Head of Marketing, VP Marketing and CMO engagements for pre-seed to Series C startups
- [CØNVERGENCE](https://convergencegroupe.com/): the company site

## Now

- Senior Associate, Business Development, Bridger Consulting Group (New York). Sells expert-network and primary-research access, full-cycle, to private equity, private credit, hedge funds, AI labs and enterprise teams. Landed the largest client in the firm's history, a top-5 global CLO manager with $97B AUM, and grew the active book by 285%.
- Strategic Advisor, CØNVERGENCE (New York, NY). Strategic brand, marketing and program leadership for high-growth startups, pre-seed to Series C. The company behind Burning Hearts. Recent engagements: Sandbar (Series A), Valka AI (pre-seed), NOX Media, Retrospect Studios, Untold (U.S. expansion), The Trenches.

## Before

- Butterfly Effect (New York and London): founding team, business development and marketing. Took the agency from zero to £1M+ ARR; signed, renewed and expanded McDonald's, HERA, Square and WeTransfer. Best Small Agency 2024 at the Global Agency Awards and the European Agency Awards.
- The 5th Column (New York): Senior Account Executive. Grew The Sandbox's SXSW launch into a $1M NFT NYC showcase; produced 25+ dealmaking events at SXSW, NFT NYC and Art Basel; placed Danvas's $7M seed round on Cheddar.
- Publicis Sapient (New York): Associate, Marketing and Communications. Placed executives in Bloomberg, CNBC, the Financial Times, Forbes and Barron's; doubled coverage from 318 to 621 clippings.
- Javelin (Washington, DC): Producer and Account Manager. Book launches and galas; the Encounter 20 Gala raised close to $1M, 63% over goal.

## Selected clients and partners

Nike, Netflix, Bumble, Birkenstock, McDonald's, Meta, FIFA, Square, WeTransfer, Google, UTA, Sonos, Verizon, The Sandbox, Macy's, Virgin Hotels, Doodles, SpaceX, Penguin Random House, Simon & Schuster, HarperCollins. 57 clients and partners in total across five chapters.

- Saturday Service (since 2024): social impact nights for early-career New Yorkers; 257 guests at launch, 1,000+ meals funded.

- 8 to 10 Dinners (since 2026): invite-only dinner series.

- 250+ dealmaking and social events produced. Partiful VIP host (top 0.1%).
